content:
The image shows a citrus leaf with clear signs of asymmetrical yellowing/mottling — the left portion of the leaf shows greenish-yellow discoloration and uneven coloration compared to the darker green areas on the right. This blotchy mottle pattern with loss of uniform dark green color is characteristic of Huanglongbing (citrus greening disease).

There is no mold, fungal growth, coremia, or fruit present — ruling out Whisker_Mold entirely.
